method: 内置 image_gen，以善功堂实机截图作为风格参照生成主页面
user_requirements: 重新出一张主页面理想图
添加材料和改造操作收进管理子页
风格再贴近善功堂，不照搬背景
main_page: 左侧单地正俯视田面贯穿主体高度，右侧紧凑状态、环境需求差距与管理田地入口，没有底部工作台。
management_subpage: 添加材料、控温、水分、光照、聚灵、物品选择、效果预览与确认投入在管理子页展开；本轮未画子页。
scope: 静态主页面理想图与现有界面规划修订；需求为定性排版示例，材料、参数和费用未定；不改代码、物品或存档。
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 Chinese cultivation-game FIELD MAIN PAGE ideal UI.
The attached image is an ACTUAL game screenshot of 善功堂 and is the STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. The user wants the same recognizable hand-painted functional UI craftsmanship, but a NEW planting composition and no copied shop background.

CRITICAL NEW DESIGN DIRECTION:
The previous version put a large modification workbench below the field. The user rejected that clutter and explicitly requests:
“主页面以田地为主，添加材料和改造操作收进管理子页，风格再贴近善功堂一点。”
This must be a CLEAN FIELD MAIN PAGE. Exactly ONE field is the visual protagonist. Only a compact status/environment sidebar and ONE “管理田地” entry. All editing lives on another page, which is CLOSED and NOT VISIBLE in this image.
ABSOLUTELY NO bottom workbench, footer panel, bottom toolbar, material slots, material cards, inventory, plus-slot, adding buttons, confirmation buttons, modification tabs, temperature controls, irrigation controls, light controls, spirit controls, before/after preview or navigation thumbnails. Do not show a management subpage inset or second screen.
Do not merely hide labels on an old panel: REMOVE that whole bottom region and let the field occupy the freed height. Exactly two body areas, one large field and one quiet side sheet.

Style transfer from the reference:
- Closely match its hand-painted desaturated grey-brown wood structure, matte shallow material depth, joined wooden corners, warm ivory paper with quiet grain, subdued blue-grey mineral accents, restrained thin traditional corner details and small pale blue-grey landscape wash in paper margins.
- Match its readable DARK regular Chinese Kaiti/slab gameplay font, title/body hierarchy and warm-paper framed buttons.
- Structure should feel like the same game family as 善功堂, with connected timber rim and a narrow shared timber divider, not a modern dashboard, not thin ink-only floating cards.
- Keep details restrained and functional. No luminous edges, glitter, bloom, fog, saturated green banners, faux gilding or giant brush-calligraphy typography.
- Do NOT reproduce the reference's tiled roof, pavilion silhouette, peak emblem, flowers, hanging signs, tassels, shop counter, four catalogue columns, goods or shop labels. No building, room, bookshelf or landscape background.
- An original shallow rectangular timber frame with blue-grey corner insets and warm-paper sidebar. Slim desaturated blue-grey outside margin only. The frame is UI trim, not a physical raised planter.
- Entirely NEW composition. Reuse the style and material language, never the background.

LAYOUT — IMPORTANT:
A shallow full-width header only 8–9% of screen height. Centered paper title plaque with ordinary dark text “瑶圃峰 · 一号田”. Right small paper button “返回田地”. No extra title “灵草种植”, no duplicated large field title.
Below header there are EXACTLY TWO AREAS extending almost to the bottom:
LEFT about 70% width, full remaining height: a single uninterrupted top-down planting ground, almost edge-to-edge within a narrow framing rim.
RIGHT about 30% width, full remaining height: a single warm paper information sheet, with a short status block, compact environment/need comparison, short mismatch message and one clear “管理田地” button.
No bottom horizontal rail across the field that creates a third section. No unnecessary second header or tab row above the field.

THE FIELD — main visual:
Exactly one continuous rectangular piece of ordinary earth, viewed from strictly vertical overhead, no perspective. It fills the left two thirds and reaches near the bottom edge. Soft broad hand-painted warm grey-brown earth planes, faint irregular brush-drawn shallow furrow lines that suggest workable ground but do not partition it into plots. Low subtle earthen perimeter and extremely narrow muted grass hints only, no bright lawn, dense pebbles, photoreal gravel, wooden planting box, trees, springs, ponds, rocks, buildings or characters.
This is an unplanted starting plot, so no crop plants. The other starting plots in the wider system have the same baseline; do not create innate natural terrain bonuses.
No internal grid, multiple beds, subplots, little field cards or capacity labels.
Do not overlay action buttons, resource statistics or decorative text in the middle of the ground. Keep the land itself unobstructed.

RIGHT PAPER SHEET — compact and readable:
Heading “灵草与环境”.
Small understated status “未定植”.
A compact target selector reading “目标灵草：月露苔” with a tiny downward triangle.
Then a short clean three-column list. Headers:
“条件” | “当前” | “需求”
Five evenly spaced rows with subtle horizontal separators, not boxed spreadsheet cells:
“温度” | “偏暖” | “凉润”
“灵力” | “偏低” | “充足”
“水分” | “湿润” | “湿润”
“光照” | “直射” | “遮阴”
“土层” | “普通土层” | “阴湿岩面”
Current unmet entries get a small muted terracotta × directly beside the current word, current water gets a small sage ✓. Keep the actual Chinese words fully legible; symbols supplement words.
Under the list a concise heading “需处理” with these short lines:
“温度偏暖、灵力不足。”
“光照过强，土层不符。”
A single prominent-but-quiet warm-paper framed button “管理田地” below the summary, inside this SIDE SHEET. This is the only main action button besides 返回田地 and target selection.
Do not add explanations underneath this button. Leave enough breathing room that it feels like the reference game's paper information panel, but not a huge blank action area.

SEMANTICS:
Viewing field status is the main page; adding actual materials and changing environment happen after entering 管理田地. No editing controls or preview appears on main.
This example is not planted, so no “停长”, “受损”, health bar, countdown, harvest button or planted-crop status. No fictional numeric thresholds, costs, inventory quantities, success rates, capacity, yields or timer.
Do not use the word 基质. Do not show preset substrate types or additive recipe examples. No developer notes, wireframe annotations or future-feature labels in the UI.

Final hard check: only ONE field, field visually dominant and full body height; one compact right information sheet; bottom workbench entirely GONE; 管理田地 is an entry to a CLOSED subpage; real 善功堂 wooden-frame / warm-paper / blue-grey / dark Kaiti family resemblance; no copied shop background or roof. Deliver one polished finished screenshot, no watermark.
